title: Late Breaking Result: AQFP-aware Binary Neural Network Architecture Search
problem: Developing AQFP-based neural network accelerators faces critical challenges from both hardware and software sides that prevent comprehensive solutions. The framework must co-design neural network architectures and hardware configurations specifically for AQFP superconducting logic.
motivation: AQFP is a superconducting logic technology with extremely high energy efficiency, making it valuable for specialized neural network acceleration.
method: The paper proposes an AQFP-aware binary neural network architecture search framework that jointly optimizes network architectures and hardware configurations through software-hardware co-optimization. The framework searches the design space of both the neural network topology and AQFP hardware parameters simultaneously to find effective implementations.
key_novelty: Software-hardware co-optimization approach for simultaneous neural architecture search and AQFP hardware configuration optimization.
contributions: AQFP-aware architecture search framework for binary neural networks
Software-hardware co-optimization methodology for AQFP accelerator design
Joint optimization of network architecture and hardware configuration
Demonstrated performance improvements over prior AQFP-based frameworks
primary_theme: AQFP architecture search for binary neural networks
